entities.summary: The Xbox app, also known as Xbox on PC and formerly known as Xbox PC, developed by Microsoft Gaming for Windows, Android, iOS and Tizen, is a companion app for users of Xbox video game consoles, providing access to Xbox network community features, remote control, as well as second screen functionality with selected games, applications, and content.
